# Import data and libraries


```{r}
# readr can read in .gz files, so this line can stay
```

# Extract promoter regions

## WGBS

```{r}
wgbs_gr <- GRanges(seqnames = wgbs$chrom,
        ranges = IRanges(start = wgbs$start, end = wgbs$end),
        strand = wgbs$strand,
        accession = wgbs$accession,
        methylation_percent = wgbs$methylation_percent)

head(wgbs_gr)
```

```{r, warning=FALSE}
promoter_regions <- promoters(genes(hg38_txdb, single.strand.genes.only=FALSE), upstream=2000, downstream=400)
```

```{r}
wgbs$in_promoter <- overlapsAny(wgbs_gr, promoter_regions, ignore.strand = TRUE)
```

```{r}
wgbs_filtered <- wgbs %>%
    filter(in_promoter == TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::select(-c(in_promoter))

dim(wgbs_filtered)  # so 4482 of 100000 sites remain, which seems reasonable (CpGs enriched in promoters, but they're not as common overall in the genome)
```

```{r}
head(wgbs_filtered)  # so now we have only CpGs that are in promoters
```

## RNA-seq

```{r}
suppressMessages(
    hg38_genes <- genes(hg38_txdb)
)
rna_seq_ranges <- hg38_genes[hg38_genes$gene_id %in% rna_seq$gene_id]

head(rna_seq_ranges)
```

```{r}
rna_seq_promoters <- promoters(rna_seq_ranges, upstream=2000, downstream=400)
```

```{r}
rm(rna_seq, wgbs, )
```
